propositions: Cancelled ACLI link delete commands increment links_applied despite failing, causing batch_outcome to report error=None with nonzero links_applied for zero actual deletions.
Link delete operations receive stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL and prompt for confirmation, causing ACLI to report 'command cancelled' on every pass when --yes flag is absent.

The except CalledProcessError arm in _update_one_dispatch_links treats all failures as idempotent 404/409 races and increments links_applied without verifying the failure reason or printing diagnostics.
REBAR_RECONCILER_FAIL_SILENT_NOOP canary cannot detect this divergence because the arm inflates links_applied to equal links_computed, defeating the canary's test of computed>0 and applied==0.
Idempotent race detection must inspect both stderr and stdout combined, matching acli.py:739 precedent, to avoid false-positive failures when 404/not-found markers land on stdout instead of stderr.
Adding --yes to both link subcommands (verified accepted in acli 1.3.19-stable help) and a links_failed counter reported in batch_outcome enables correct failure tracking and canary detection.
